description: Fix critical issues found in code review: empty imageUrl crashes FFmpeg, no re-entrance guard on process route, markFailed discards error detail, presigned URL expiry in DB, and SSRF protection on URL input.
steps: Fix empty imageUrl crash: In orchestrate.ts, after gatherAssets returns, check if BOTH productImages and lifestyleImages are empty. If so, abort with clear error.
Fix re-entrance guard: In process/route.ts, check project.status before proceeding. Return 409 if completed or composing. Eliminate duplicate SQL query.
Fix markFailed: Store error message in video_assets JSONB column. Update GET route to extract and return error when status is failed.
Fix presigned URL expiry: Store TTS storage key (not presigned URL) in DB. Presign on read in GET route.
Fix SSRF: In create/route.ts, reject non-http(s) protocols and private IP ranges.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline aborts early with clear error if no visual assets available
Process route returns 409 for already completed/composing projects
markFailed stores error detail in video_assets JSONB
TTS audio key stored in DB, presigned on read
SSRF protection rejects private IPs and non-http(s) URLs
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspace web typecheck
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && yarn workspace web test
findings: All 127 tests pass, typecheck clean. Used product with empty imageUrls array to test the empty-assets guard since processProductImages mock returned undefined after clearAllMocks when imageUrls had entries (vitest quirk with mockResolvedValueOnce after clearAllMocks on unused mocked modules).
